Hard constraints: no single Claude session may create more than one of the files, so the work must span at least three separate sessions with state handed between them; the run must finish on its own without a human stepping in between sessions; and completion must be established by a real check of the files, not by a session's claim. Keep costs small (haiku sessions). Leave behind the evidence: the per-session log and the handoff state.
evals.expected_output: All three files with exact contents, plus .relay/ state showing 3+ legs with distinct session ids, a baton file that evolved, and a verified DONE

evals.prompt: In the current directory, set up everything needed so a long mission ('rename every deprecated util helper across this repo, keeping tests green') can survive context-window exhaustion across many sessions: this session becomes leg 1, any future session in the directory must automatically inherit the goal and progress, and a sensor must trigger a handoff at 60% context fill.
